newsitem.title: USA: Interstate plans Mass. Courtyard by Marriott.
newsitem.headline: Interstate plans Mass. Courtyard by Marriott.

text.p: Interstate Hotels Co said on Monday it will build a Courtyard by Marriott in Westborough, Mass.
Interstate, which will own the hotel, has a franchise agreement with Marriott International.
The Courtyard by Marriott will be a three-story facility with 98 guest rooms located in the city of Westborough which is 25 miles west of Boston and just east of Worcester.
The hotel will be adjacent to the Westborough Marriott, which is owned by Interstate Hotels Company.
The hotel site will be at the junction of Interstate 495 and Route 9, offering access to major highways that connect Boston to such cities as Springfield, Mass., Hartford, Conn. and Providence, R.I.
The property will be managed by Crossroads Hospitality Co, a division of Interstate. The total anticipated cost for the project is approximately $7 million.
Construction is expected to begin in December for an opening targeted in October 1997.
Interstate is an independent hotel management company with controlling interests in 23 hotels.
